item.title: Configuring the LLM provider settings
item.description:
Konveyor AI is large language model (LLM) agnostic and integrates with an LLM of your choice. To enable Konveyor AI to access your large language model (LLM), you must enter the LLM provider configurations in the provider-settings.yaml file.

The provider-settings.yaml file contains a list of LLM providers that are supported by default. The mandatory environment variables are different for each LLM provider. Depending on the provider that you choose, you can configure additional environment variables for a model in the provider-settings.yaml file. You can also enter a new provider with the required environment variables, the base URL, and the model name.

item.title: Configuring the LLM in Podman Desktop
item.description:
The Podman AI lab extension enables you to use an open-source model from a curated list of models and use it locally in your system.

The code fix suggestions generated by a model depends on the model’s capabilities. Models deployed through the Podman AI Lab were found to be insufficient for the complexity of code changes required to fix issues discovered by Konveyor. You must not use such models in a production environment.
